description: Royal City Clashers 3 is the next epic title from the bloodthirsty and retro Royal City Clashers series. Trouble in Royal City never ends – this city is full of violence, lawbreaking and unruly behaviour and it is your job to try and bring order to the streets and eliminate various enemies, thugs and aliens!
